name: University Campus
description: Something important was happening here when it stopped. The buildings are large and institutional. The quiet feels different — like interrupted work, not abandoned living.

campus_gate.name: Campus Gate
campus_gate.description: Stone pillars, iron gates standing open. A hand-painted banner has rotted away but the frame is still bolted to the arch.

artifacts.description: Iron bolts from the banner frame. Still solid.

admin_courtyard.name: Administration Courtyard
admin_courtyard.description: A wide open space with a dry fountain at the centre. Offices ring the perimeter. Most doors are open.

artifacts.description: A faculty ID lanyard. The photo is bleached, the name still legible: Dr. K. Osei, Computational Ethics.

admin_records_room.name: Records Room
admin_records_room.description: Filing cabinets, most hanging open. Somebody searched here in a hurry. One cabinet in the back is locked.

hazards.description: The ceiling tiles have partially collapsed. Vera steps carefully around the debris.

artifacts.description: A locked filing cabinet. The lock is simple — a bent paperclip opens it.
artifacts.field_note: Flash drives, sealed in a grip-bag. Whoever packed this was hoping to come back.

library_entrance.name: Library Entrance Hall
library_entrance.description: High ceilings. Most of the shelves are still standing. Paper books hold up better than anyone expected.

artifacts.description: A date stamp from the circulation desk. Last stamped: October 14th.
A thumb drive taped inside the front cover of a book on information theory.

library_special_collections.name: Special Collections
library_special_collections.description: Climate-controlled, or it was. The seals held longer than expected. Archival boxes, acid-free. Someone was very deliberate about what they stored here — AI safety papers, alignment research preprints, printed and boxed by hand.

artifacts.description: A hardened research storage case, aluminium, foam-lined. Labelled in marker: 'ALIGNMENT — DO NOT RECYCLE'.
artifacts.field_note: Optical discs, individually sleeved. Someone printed every major alignment paper and burned them to disc as backup. They knew.

artifacts.description: A printed preprint, annotated in two different inks. The margin notes disagree with each other.

library_server_room.name: Library Server Room
library_server_room.description: The door was propped open from the inside. Someone left in the middle of something. Server racks still standing, drives dark.

hazards.description: No ambient light. The ventilation ducts are sealed and the room has no windows.

artifacts.description: A hot-swap drive bay still holding a drive. The label reads: 'LLA_BACKUP_FINAL_v3'.

engineering_quad.name: Engineering Quad
engineering_quad.description: The largest building on campus. Lab benches visible through ground-floor windows. The work was mid-step — instruments still on the tables, notebooks open.

artifacts.description: A wire-bound lab notebook. Water-damaged but readable. The last entry is a list of things to do Monday.

engineering_lab_b3.name: Lab B3 — Applied Systems
engineering_lab_b3.description: A graduate student workspace. Personal effects mixed with equipment. Mugs with mould long since dried to dust. Whiteboards still full.

hazards.description: A pipe ruptured at some point. The floor holds a few centimetres of standing water.

artifacts.description: A waterproof case on a high shelf — the researcher who put it there was thinking ahead. Sticker on the lid: a small red triangle.
artifacts.field_note: Tape reels in a waterproof case. The triangle sticker means hazard data. Or it meant something to whoever packed it.
